description.fun: Bellsprout's thin stem is so flexible that it can swerve out of the way of attacks and snap at prey with blinding speed, spitting a corrosive acid. It plants its foot-like roots in the ground to drink, though then it can't run away. Its Japanese name, Madatsubomi, means 'still in bud'.
description.guide: A small Grass and Poison Pokémon with a bell-shaped head on a thin, flexible stem and roots it uses as feet. It catches prey with quick strikes and corrosive acid, and roots itself in the ground to take in water. It evolves into Weepinbell and then Victreebel.
description.tagline: A bendy flower bud with acid spit and fast reflexes

description.fun: Weepinbell disguises itself as an ordinary forest plant and waits for prey to wander close. Then it sprays a paralysing powder and melts its catch with acid, protected from its own juices by a neutralising fluid, and slices up anything too big to swallow with razor-sharp leaves. It sleeps hanging from a branch by its stem, and if it fidgets, it may wake up on the ground.
description.guide: The middle stage of Bellsprout's line, a bell-shaped Grass and Poison Pokémon based on a pitcher plant. It camouflages itself as a plant, sprays poison powder to stop prey and dissolves it with acid. It evolves into Victreebel with a Leaf Stone.
description.tagline: A hanging pitcher plant that melts what it catches

description.fun: Victreebel waves the long vine on its lid like a little animal and gives off a sweet, honey-like scent to lure prey into its mouth, where an acid that can dissolve anything waits. It's said to live in huge colonies deep in the jungle, though no one who went looking has ever come back.
description.guide: The final stage of Bellsprout's line, a large, pitcher plant-like Grass and Poison Pokémon that lures prey with a sweet scent and dissolves it in acid. It evolves from Weepinbell with a Leaf Stone. Victreebel can Mega Evolve into Mega Victreebel.
description.tagline: A sweet-smelling trap with acid inside

description.fun: Swells to about 2.65 times Victreebel's height, a bigger jump than any other Mega Evolution, so full of acid that it ties its vine around its throat to keep it in. Instead of waiting for prey, it hops after it and fans out dizzying sweet fumes.
